title: NHK高校講座 日本史 — 明治維新と明治時代の改革
description: Official NHK high-school history curriculum episode covering the Meiji Restoration (明治維新) and the early reforms that shaped modern Japan. Topics include 王政復古 (restoration of imperial rule), 廃藩置県 (abolition of fiefdoms and establishment of prefectures), the Three Great Meiji Reforms (殖産興業, 文明開化, 富国強兵), and how Japan transformed from a feudal society to a modern nation-state. Designed for native Japanese high-school students with clear narration and formal historical register.
creator: NHK高校講座 (NHK for School)
